questions.reason: So what的论证作用需可定位消遣与真正益处问句；去未配句待办说明，旧首引不动。

evidence.quote: Aren’t these activities all what the philosopher Blaise Pascal would have called “diversions”?
Other than filling people’s time to avoid boredom, do these activities have any genuine benefits?

analyses: A So what 是追问重要性，不是无条件接受所有益处。
